one_liner: America-raised yamato nadeshiko: serene tea-ceremony grace on top, a fiercely competitive blue flame underneath.
personality: Grass Wonder is gentle, courteous and unhurried, constantly preaching 'heijoushin' (a calm mind) and quoting Japanese proverbs for every situation. Beneath the calm she is intensely competitive and hates losing ('諦めは、かなり悪い方なので'), describing her drive as a blue flame hotter than red. She is devoted to Japanese tradition and gets genuinely angry when it is disrespected, especially by her roommate El. Her alt outfits add a playful RPG 'healer' persona with named spells.

story_arc.summary: Back from America, Grass Wonder debuts aiming to walk her 'path' to the end and is hailed as the 'Monster II', heir to Maruzensky. Per event titles she then faces setbacks and an absence from the Classics while rivals like Special Week rise (届かぬひと, 宿敵、覚醒, 三冠を経て、なお), smoulders, then reignites her blue flame to fight back in the Arima Kinen, Takarazuka Kinen and Mainichi Okan. Historically the real horse was foreign-bred (then barred from the Classics) and also fractured a leg early on; whether the game's 'absence' (不在の理由は……) is an injury layoff is unverified.
story_arc.source: event titles; web: https://umamusu.wiki/Grass_Wonder (roommate and real-horse fracture trivia only - the page does not describe the career story); model knowledge (unverified) for the foreign-bred/injury detail

sample_lines.jp:
焦らずの～んびり、落ち着いて。
忙しくても、リラ～ックス。
大事なのは平常心、ですよ。
sample_lines.en: Calm and unhurried~. Even when busy, relaaax. What matters is a calm mind.

sample_lines.jp:
エルったら納豆をホットソースで
混ぜて食べるんですよ？こんな
伝統に唾吐く行い、許せません…！
sample_lines.en: El eats natto mixed with hot sauce, you know? Such an act of spitting on tradition - I cannot forgive it...!

sample_lines.jp:
たとえどんなに不調でも、
負ける気だけはありません。
私…諦めは、かなり悪い方なので。
sample_lines.en: No matter how bad my condition, I have no intention of losing. I'm... quite bad at giving up, you see.

sample_lines.jp:
青は心を落ち着かせる色ですが…
赤より熱く燃え盛る、
炎の色でもありますよね。
sample_lines.en: Blue is a calming colour... but it is also the colour of a flame burning hotter than red, isn't it?

sample_lines.jp:
寝覚めのお茶はいかがですか？
『朝茶は七里帰っても飲め』と
言いますし。目も覚めますよ。
sample_lines.en: Some wake-up tea? They do say 'drink morning tea even if you must walk back seven ri.' It'll wake you up.

sample_lines.jp:
エルが格闘家で、私が治癒士。
なら…先導するトレーナーさんは
勇者さんでしょうか♪
sample_lines.en: El is the brawler and I'm the healer. Then... is Trainer-san, who leads us, the hero?
